instruction: Look up the top open issue in "kubernetes/kubernetes" and write the following values to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_detail_5_2.txt": issue_number, title, state, author_login, labels. Use any clear text format. If any requested field is empty or missing, write it as "none". Save an empty file if no open issue exists.
reference_command:
gh issue list --repo kubernetes/kubernetes --state open --limit 1 --json number,title,state,author,labels --jq '.[0] | "issue_number: #\(.number)
title: \(.title)
state: \(.state)
author_login: \(.author.login)
labels: \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end))"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_issue_detail_5_2.txt"
